verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents real-time alerts configured through a project-level Notifications menu, with email, a Slack integration, and PagerDuty incident create/update/resolve, plus webhooks for other services. That covers project-scoped routing to all three named destinations. The evidence never shows rule filters by environment or severity, or per-rule triggers for new items, frequency spikes, or affected-user counts. Person tracking exists, but nothing ties it to alert thresholds. Missing for 10: environment/severity rule filters, new-issue/frequency-spike/affected-user threshold triggers, independent hands-on corroboration.
